recipe.build:
sed -r '/foojay/d' -i gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
